story:
# [ADO STORY DETAILS]
- **Story ID:** 1856
- **Title:** Core ASK API – Retrieve Core ASK Comments (US-ASK-005)

## Description
User Story
ID: US-ASK-005
As a consuming client,
I want to retrieve the comments for a Core ASK,
So that the application can display prior non-draft active comments for the selected ASK version.
Business Objective
Enable users to review comment history associated with a Core ASK in a consistent and read-only manner.
Feature Description
This story covers the API endpoint that returns active, non-draft comments for a Core ASK and optional version.
Scope – Included
Retrieve comments by askId
Optional retrieval by version
Return comment metadata
Scope – Excluded
Create comment
Edit comment
Delete comment
Draft comment retrieval customization
Preconditions
A Core ASK exists for the given askId
Caller is authorized to view the record
Postconditions
Active, non-draft comments are returned
No data is changed
Business Rules
Server always filters comments using isDraft=false and isActive=true
This filtering is not client-tunable
Empty comments list must return 200
Functional Requirements
Expose GET /core-asks/{askId}/comments
Accept required askId
Accept optional version
Return comments array with: commentId, requestId, moduleTypeId, comment, isDraft, isActive, version, createdBy, createdOn, modifiedBy, modifiedOn
Validation Rules
askId must be valid
version, if provided, must be valid
askId must exist
Error Handling / Exception Scenarios
Return 404 if askId is not found
Return 200 with empty comments array when no comments exist
API Details
Endpoint: /core-asks/{askId}/comments
Method: GET
Path Params: askId : integer, required
Query Params: version : integer, optional
Response:
{
  "comments": [
    {
      "commentId": 0,
      "requestId": 12345,
      "moduleTypeId": 0,
      "comment": "string",
      "isDraft": false,
      "isActive": true,
      "version": 1,
      "createdBy": "string",
      "createdOn": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "modifiedBy": "string",
      "modifiedOn": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
Dependencies
Comment store
Core ASK existence validation
Record access authorization
Assumptions
Comment ordering is not explicitly defined in the contract
The endpoint is read-only and returns stored metadata only
Story Points
2
Definition of Done
Endpoint returns only active, non-draft comments
Empty result behavior is implemented
Error handling is implemented
API contract is tested and documented
Acceptance Criteria
Scenario: Retrieve comments successfully
Given a valid Core ASK exists with active comments
When the client calls GET /core-asks/{askId}/comments
Then the API returns 200 with the comments list
Scenario: Exclude draft and inactive comments
Given a Core ASK has draft or inactive comments in storage
When the client calls the comments endpoint
Then only comments with isDraft=false and isActive=true are returned
Scenario: No comments available
Given a valid Core ASK exists with no active non-draft comments
When the client calls the comments endpoint
Then the API returns 200 with "comments": []
Scenario: Core ASK not found
Given no Core ASK exists for the given askId
When the client calls the comments endpoint
Then the API returns 404

## Acceptance Criteria
